features.description: Add static-artefact sandbox-proxy mode to mcp-sandbox: new /sandbox-static.html page running the MCP Apps spec sandbox-proxy handshake for static (non-agent-summoned) artefacts.
acceptance_criteria: GET /sandbox-static.html returns 200 with ADR-013 CSP headers
Manual browser smoke: page loads boldkast/v1, handshake notifications visible in DevTools console, no errors
esbuild build for the new entry succeeds in CI
Spec compliance: sends ui/notifications/sandbox-proxy-ready, awaits ui/notifications/sandbox-resource-ready, forwards ui/initialize and ui/update-model-context bidirectionally per spec lines 470-487
features.notes: Scope reduced significantly: the existing /sandbox.html + sandbox.ts at infrastructure/mcp-sandbox/ is already a spec-compliant sandbox-proxy bridge (adapted from modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps reference). The /artefacts/<name>/v<n>/ route already serves raw artefact HTML. So M1 is just (a) verify the path works for the static-artefact use case, (b) add 2 acceptance tests pinning the contract M2 will rely on. No new sandbox-static.html or sandbox-static.ts needed — those files in the original plan were redundant with what shipped already.

features.description: StaticArtefactFrame host component + useMcpAppMessages hook. Generic spec-compliant host wrapper that mounts the sandbox-proxy iframe, completes ui/initialize handshake, parses JSON-RPC envelopes, routes ui/update-model-context to a caller callback. Origin-based auth works because the sandbox-proxy has a real origin.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test:run -- StaticArtefactFrame useMcpAppMessages green (all reject + happy-path cases covered)
npm run quality:check green
No emoji in new files
ui/initialize handshake completes; hostContext payload includes theme + displayMode + locale
e.origin !== sandboxOrigin events rejected; e.origin === sandboxOrigin events with valid JSON-RPC envelope forwarded
features.notes: Two new files (StaticArtefactFrame.tsx ~250 LOC + useMcpAppMessages.ts ~90 LOC) + two test suites (19 tests across 290 LOC). Spec compliance: §Sandbox proxy handshake (sandbox-proxy-ready, sandbox-resource-ready), §Standard MCP Messages (ui/initialize -> hostContext, ui/notifications/initialized, ui/update-model-context, ping). Auth via origin (e.origin === sandboxOrigin) — the spec-canonical approach for the sandbox-proxy pattern.

features.description: Boldkast artefact rewritten to emit MCP Apps JSON-RPC notifications (ui/update-model-context) instead of raw postMessage. Adds ~30 LOC of vanilla-JS JSON-RPC helpers (rpcRequest, rpcNotify) per spec line 428. Runs ui/initialize handshake on load. Adds ping responder.
acceptance_criteria: ?test=1 self-test passes (document.title becomes 'TEST PASS')
DevTools console shows ui/initialize request, handshake response, and ui/update-model-context notification on every meaningful student interaction
Artefact total size under 200KB ceiling (wc -c index.html < 200000)
Handshake completes before first user-driven emit (no race)
features.notes: Can run in parallel with M2 — different code paths
